segment.source: Renders a checklist of what a price covers: a tick against everything included and a struck-through dash against everything that is not, in one to four columns. Use it for: the list under a single price, the small print of a package, a 'what you get' band on a service page, the summary above a booking button. Prefer 'Feature Comparison Matrix' when the point is the difference between plans, and 'Add-On List' when the missing items can be bought separately.
